item.description: Pythdotos #3234 the Twice-Born of the Argyreoi fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.title: Kallgenes #7501 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphode
item.description: Kallgenes #7501 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Agathdoros #2256 the Twice-Bo
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Agathdoros #2256 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares.

item.title: Eurippos #7817 and Chrysippos #6681 the Twice-Born fought in Bear Mountain. Both limp now;
item.description: Eurippos #7817 and Chrysippos #6681 the Twice-Born fought in Bear Mountain. Both limp now; neither will forget.
